description: This file provides an internal implementation of the 'invoke' utility, including compatibility for different C++ standards, and defines how to invoke various callable entities such as member functions, member data, and general functions, following the C++ standard [func.require].

classes.name: StrippedAccept
classes.description: A helper template to remove cv-qualifiers and references from arguments for accept checks.

classes.name: MemFunAndRef
classes.description: Implements invocation for member functions when the object is a reference or object of the class.

classes.name: MemFunAndPtr
classes.description: Implements invocation for member functions when the object is a pointer to an object.

classes.name: DataMemAndRef
classes.description: Handles invocation for member data when the object is a reference or object.

classes.name: DataMemAndPtr
classes.description: Handles invocation for member data when the object is a pointer.

classes.name: Callable
classes.description: Handles invocation for general callables in all other cases.

classes.name: Invoker
classes.description: Selects the appropriate invocation method based on argument types.

classes.name: is_invocable_r
classes.description: Type trait to check if a callable can be invoked with given arguments and the result is convertible to R.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main function implementing the invocation logic, choosing the correct invocation method based on argument types.
